purpose: small real-PCAP development-only support audit and feature conversion timing

execution_scope.capture_order: lexicographic capture path, stop when either cap is reached

prefix_contract.stats: only first P packet lengths/directions and first P timestamps; duration ends at Pth packet
prefix_contract.temporal: only first P packet lengths/directions and first P-1 non-negative IATs
prefix_contract.short_flow: packet_count
prefix_contract.future_guard: mutate post-P tail in a synthetic Segment and require prefix vectors unchanged

timing_contract.feature_stage: Stats and Temporal prefix conversion separately
timing_contract.model_load_or_inference: not measured in this pilot; no prefix bundle available

failure_contract.timeout_injection: synthetic contract test only; no PCAP timeout deletion

locked_interpretation: This pilot supports prefix availability and feature-conversion cost only. It cannot support quality, model fairness, real inference latency, or end-to-end acceleration claims.
